Ivana Horvat to Rosa Vidal: “Good morning, Rosa. I'm Ivana. I'm here to get to know the town and its people. Thank you for the welcome.”
Luka Babić: “I'm here for work. There's a mill roof that needs fixing.”
Ana Perić: “Hi, I'm Ana. I'm a journalist - editor of the Gazette actually. I'm here looking for stories. What's the situation with that mill roof?”
Vesna Marić: “Morning. I'm Vesna, I run the chandlery. Need anything from the harbor?”

text: Rosa Vidal: “Welcome, Ivana. I'm Rosa, I run the inn. You'll want to stay with us - best place to hear what's really happening in town. Ana, always chasing stories. That mill roof's been a problem for weeks now. Luka, you looking for work? We could use someone reliable.”
Petar Ilić: “Morning. I'm Petar, I run the bakery here. That mill roof - it's been causing problems for weeks. The mill's not producing like it should. If someone can get it fixed, we'd all benefit.”

Ivana Horvat to Ana Perić: “Ana, is it. I'm Ivana Horvat. I'm the new mayor, as you may know. A mill roof issue sounds like something I should understand better. Do you have more details on what's needed?”
Luka Babić: “Mill roof needs fixing. I can do it. Need materials and someone to help with the high work.”
Ana Perić to Petar Ilić: “Petar, right? I'm Ana, from the Gazette. This mill roof problem - how long has it been affecting production? What exactly is broken?”
Vesna Marić went to the chandlery.

Rosa Vidal: “Ivana, welcome to Ferry Town. I'm Rosa Vidal, I run the harbor inn. You'll find most of what matters happens over a drink there. And you're already seeing it - the mill roof's been our headache for weeks. Luka here knows how to fix it, but he'll need backing and materials. That's the kind of thing gets people talking, and talking gets things done.”

Petar Ilić: “The mill roof, yes. It's been killing us. Luka's right - it needs fixing, and I need that mill working again. I've been covering costs I can't afford. If you can get the materials and do the work, I'll back it. What do you need?”
Ivana Horvat was taken on as dock hand.
Rosa Vidal went to the harbor inn.
Luka Babić went to the market square.

Ana Perić to Petar Ilić: “Morning, Petar. I'm Ana, I'm the editor of the Gazette. I just got here yesterday and I'm already hearing about this mill roof problem. Sounds like it's affecting the whole town. Mind if I ask you some questions about it for a piece I'm working on?”

Rosa Vidal reflected: Day 1. Stepped off the ferry with a suitcase and 40 coins. Three nights paid at the harbor inn. I got work as help at the inn. 2 coins a shift. Ana Perić told me: Ana Perić says the mayor asked for the survey to stall the vote.
Petar Ilić wrote to you: “Stepped off the ferry with a suitcase and 40 coins. Three nights paid at the harbor inn. Tell me what you would do.”
